narrative: Regime read: Cautiously Neutral (composite score -0.06 on a -1 to +1 scale). Finance conditions are cautious (-0.17), economic data is roughly balanced (+0.09), and market psychology leans roughly balanced (-0.06), with the economy in an Expansion phase.

ISM PMI at 53.3 shows expansion, with neither the yield curve nor unemployment flashing late-cycle strain. (standard business-cycle framing — sentiment reads differently depending on where the cycle stands.)

Psychology isn't pulling the read away from fundamentals right now — the fundamentals-only baseline (-0.06) and the full psychology-adjusted composite (-0.06) are essentially the same. Psychology is calm enough that it's only weighted 17% of the final read (vs. a floor of 15% and a ceiling of 55% when conditions get extreme).

No single extreme-positioning signal (herding, loss-aversion-driven hedging, overconfidence, or a Minsky-style extended-calm streak) is flashing right now — sentiment, hedging demand, and volatility all look within a normal range.
